parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.sport, t.name, t.description, t.logo_key, t.banner_key, t.category, t.city, t.area, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, t.match_days, t.match_timing, t.format, t.group_count, t.qualify_per_group, t.max_teams, t.squad_min, t.squad_max, t.entry_fee, t.prize_type, t.prize_details, t.food_provided, t.meals, t.jersey_provided, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registration_deadline, t.visibility, t.status, o.name AS organizer_name, o.is_verified AS organizer_verified, r.match_rules, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(g.name) FROM tournament_grounds g WHERE g.tournament_id = t.id) AS grounds, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('doc_type', d.doc_type, 'title', d.title, 'file_key', d.file_key, 'mime_type', d.mime_type, 'sort_order', d.sort_order)) FROM tournament_documents d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS documents, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'label', s.label, 'is_title', s.is_title, 'logo_key', s.logo_key, 'banner_key', s.banner_key, 'link_url', s.link_url, 'tagline', s.tagline, 'sort_order', s.sort_order)) FROM tournament_sponsors s WHERE s.tournament_id = t.id) AS sponsors, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name', v.name, 'sort_order', v.sort_order, 'min_age', v.min_age, 'max_age', v.max_age, 'format', v.format, 'max_teams', v.max_teams, 'entry_fee', v.entry_fee, 'prize_type', v.prize_type, 'prize_details', v.prize_details, 'match_rules', v.match_rules, 'approved_teams', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = v.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED'))) FROM tournament_divisions v WHERE v.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_teams FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_rules r ON r.tournament_id = t.id WHERE t.code = $1 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 404, body: { success: false, message: 'Tournament not found.' } } }];
